lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: Huff... I've been walking in circles for hours. My legs are barely holding up.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: Just how much deeper does this cursed labyrinth go?

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: Wait... is that a light glowing ahead? A shop stall... down here?!

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: Talk about bizarre timing, but I won't complain.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: I desperately need some potions and food before I collapse. Let's see what's in stock.
